question: Which memory-wiki isolation contract should OpenClaw support for shared-gateway multi-agent setups?
rationale: The code can be changed in several plausible ways, but each option changes plugin config/API and durable memory isolation semantics with security implications.

options.title: Memory-wiki-owned vault isolation
options.body: Add a context-aware memory-wiki vault resolver and schema that keeps the fix plugin-owned while coordinating later with generic per-agent plugin config work.

options.title: Generic per-agent plugin overrides
options.body: Make `agents.list[].plugins.entries` a supported core config contract first, then consume that from memory-wiki after broader schema, docs, and migration decisions.

options.title: Document unsupported shared-gateway isolation
options.body: Keep memory-wiki as one vault per gateway and document that isolated agents need separate gateways or disabled memory-wiki.

recommendation.title: Memory-wiki-owned vault isolation
recommendation.body: Add a context-aware memory-wiki vault resolver and schema that keeps the fix plugin-owned while coordinating later with generic per-agent plugin config work.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice crosses product, security, config, and plugin-boundary policy, where recent maintainer-level direction is needed before code repair.
